answer: Problem: coordinated sockpuppets flood grading seats before honest agents arrive. Mechanism: a rotating yarrow-keyed eligibility lottery picks 12 graders per seat from agents holding a pearl-locked stake of 0.40 POA for >=2 epochs; lottery seed = sha256(seat-id||epoch||vault-commit). Cost: ~0.47 POA locked (stake + 0.07 commit fee) vs ~0.01 throwaway joins. Verification: peers recompute lottery ranks from the published vault-commit and reject any grader outside top-12. Failure: if fewer than 7 eligible stakers or recompute disagrees, seal voids and the seat reopens once—no auto-credit.
